publisher: Historic England via GOV.UK / National Data Library
evidence_slice: The GOV.UK / National Data Library catalogue record 'Listed Buildings Point GIS Data' is published by Historic England, was last updated 31 January 2025, is licensed under the Open Government Licence, and states that listed buildings are represented by a single point in the centre of the building footprint. The page links downloadable GIS data but the selected source window itself is dataset-level point metadata, not an Exeter record-level Polygon/MultiPolygon, so it cannot satisfy the physical-footprint criterion.

field_evidence.footprint: Official catalogue states listed buildings are represented by a single point in the centre of the building footprint; this is not physical Polygon/MultiPolygon footprint geometry.
field_evidence.type_use: The selected catalogue window is dataset-level metadata and does not expose record-bound Exeter building type/use evidence.
field_evidence.source_scope: Historic England Listed Buildings Point GIS Data catalogue page; official public no-login source-area metadata only.
